text: The design shall place the Nano, the EC11 encoder and the OLED module from the parts catalogue, with the Nano's mini-USB port facing the back end of the box and the encoder and the OLED mounted on the top panel side by side with a gap between them, without the parts colliding, and shall declare that layout.
The Nano shall be held on four posts, one through each of its four mounting holes, standing clear of the pin headers under the board.

The top panel shall be a flat plate 3 mm thick that is the removable lid: a separate body that locates on the base with a sliding fit and is held closed by four M3 self-tapping screws (from the parts catalogue) into bosses in the base.

The panel shall carry the encoder through a bushing hole, with the encoder's body against the panel's underside, its nut able to seat flat on the panel's top face, and at least 0.5 mm of the bushing's thread projecting past the nut.
The encoder's shaft and nut shall have free space above the panel: nothing printed shall touch the shaft or the nut, and the OLED window shall stay at least 2 mm from the nut.

The OLED shall be fixed behind a window in the panel with its display glass at most 0.5 mm below the panel, and the window shall show the whole 21.74 x 10.86 mm active area and the 25 x 14 mm viewing area without clipping, with at least 1 mm of margin around the active area and the window no larger than 26.2 x 15.2 mm.

With the lid closed, a mini-USB cable shall plug fully into the Nano through one opening in the back end wall without touching the enclosure, and that opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side.
The Nano, the OLED and the encoder body shall lie inside the closed enclosure, at least 0.5 mm from every printed surface (0.2 mm for connectors and headers) and at least 0.5 mm from each other.
The closed enclosure shall have no openings other than the mini-USB opening, the encoder hole, the OLED window and screw holes, and its walls and floor shall be 2 to 4 mm thick.
The base and the lid shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports.
The closed enclosure shall be no larger than 80 x 60 x 40 mm, longest along the Nano's 45 mm side, and shall stand flat on a desk without tipping.
With the lid off, the lid with the encoder and OLED still fitted shall lift straight up off the base, and the Nano shall then drop straight down onto its posts.
The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
